# Reports & moderation

Reports about players and questions as cases: a queue by urgency, the evidence and why a case is urgent, a decision with its consequences, and the record of each player.

[CaseQueue](#casequeue) · [CasePanel](#casepanel) · [RiskSignals](#risksignals) · [DecisionForm](#decisionform) · [ViolationHistory](#violationhistory) · [ReportLog](#reportlog)

### CaseQueue

The open cases, most urgent first. A row has the priority in words, the person or question, the reasons given, how many people reported, how long it has waited, whether it is overdue (and by what rule), and who is working on it.

```ts
import { CaseQueue } from '@/contest/components/CaseQueue'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` *(required)* | `CaseItem[]` |  | The cases in the order to work them: `{ case, priority, title, detail? }`. Sort with `byPriority`. |
| `claims` *(required)* | `Record<string, Claim>` |  | Who is working on which case, by case key. |
| `onSelect` *(required)* | `(key: string) => void` |  | Called with the key of the case that was opened. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The clock, in milliseconds. |
| `actor` *(required)* | `string` |  | Who is using the queue: their own claims say "You are on it". |
| `selectedKey` | `string \| null` |  | The open case. |
| `empty` | `string` | `'No open cases.'` | Shown when the list is empty. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
const items = groupReports(reports).map((c) => ({ case: c, priority: priorityOf(c, ctx), title: nameOf(c) })).sort(byPriority)
<CaseQueue items={items} claims={claims} selectedKey={key} onSelect={setKey} now={now} actor="Ada" />
```

- J and K move through the list while nobody is typing. Priority is a word and a colour on the left edge: the word carries the meaning.

### CasePanel

One case for a moderator, top to bottom: who or what was reported and who is working on it, the reports with how reliable each reporter has been, why the case has its priority and what the data shows, the record of the player, and the decision. The decision is off while someone else holds the case; "Take over" moves it.

```ts
import { CasePanel } from '@/contest/components/CasePanel'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case` *(required)* | `ReportCase` |  | The case: the open reports about one target. See `groupReports`. |
| `targetName` *(required)* | `string` |  | The name of the player, or the text of the question. |
| `priority` *(required)* | `CasePriority` |  | How urgent it is and why. See `priorityOf`. |
| `signals` *(required)* | `Signal[]` |  | What the data shows. See `playerSignals` and `questionSignals`. |
| `reports` *(required)* | `Report[]` |  | Every report, open and handled: the record of each reporter is worked out from them. |
| `violations` *(required)* | `Violation[]` |  | Every violation on record. |
| `reporterName` *(required)* | `(id: string) => string` |  | A readable name for a reporter. |
| `actor` *(required)* | `string` |  | Who is deciding. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The clock, in milliseconds. |
| `onClaim` *(required)* | `() => void` |  | Called when the person starts working on the case, or takes it over. |
| `onRelease` *(required)* | `() => void` |  | Called when the person lets the case go. |
| `onResolve` *(required)* | `(decision: ReportDecision) => void` |  | Called with the decision when it is confirmed. |
| `preview` | `ReactNode` |  | What the target looks like, shown under the header. For a question: the question and its key. |
| `claim` | `Claim` |  | Who is working on the case now. |
| `busy` | `boolean` |  | Switches the buttons off while a decision is being saved. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<CasePanel case={c} targetName="Gus Petrov" priority={priority} signals={signals} reports={reports} violations={violations} reporterName={nameOf} claim={claims[c.key]} actor="Ada" now={now} onClaim={claim} onRelease={release} onResolve={(d) => resolve(c.key, d)} />
```

- A reporter who was right three times out of three is "Usually right"; one who was dismissed most of the time is "Often wrong" and takes a point off the priority. Both are shown, never hidden.

### RiskSignals

Why a case has the priority it has. No hidden score: every point has a sentence ("Cheating is serious +3", "3 different people reported it +2"), and under them what the data shows with how strong each sign is. An overdue case says by how long it should have been done.

```ts
import { RiskSignals } from '@/contest/components/RiskSignals'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `priority` *(required)* | `CasePriority` |  | The priority with its factors. See `priorityOf`. |
| `signals` *(required)* | `Signal[]` |  | What the data shows about the target. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<RiskSignals priority={priorityOf(c, ctx)} signals={playerSignals(c.targetId, submissions, participants)} />
```

- The strength of a sign is three small bars with a text alternative ("Strength 3 of 3"), so it does not depend on colour.

### DecisionForm

The decision on a case: pick an action (the suggested one is chosen and the form says why), see in plain words what it does, give a reason, confirm. A suspension asks for days. The button stays off, and a line says why, until the decision is complete.

```ts
import { DecisionForm } from '@/contest/components/DecisionForm'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case` *(required)* | `ReportCase` |  | The case. |
| `targetName` *(required)* | `string` |  | The name of the player or the text of the question, for the sentences about what the decision does. |
| `suggestion` *(required)* | `Suggestion` |  | The next step on the ladder. See `suggestAction`. |
| `actor` *(required)* | `string` |  | Who is deciding. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The clock, in milliseconds. |
| `onSubmit` *(required)* | `(decision: ReportDecision) => void` |  | Called with the decision when it is complete and confirmed. |
| `claim` | `Claim` |  | Who is working on the case. The form is off when it is someone else. |
| `busy` | `boolean` |  | Shows a spinner on the button. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<DecisionForm case={c} targetName={name} suggestion={suggestAction(c, { violations, signals })} actor="Ada" claim={claim} now={now} onSubmit={(d) => resolve(c.key, d)} />
```

- Players can be dismissed, warned, suspended (1 to 30 days) or disqualified; questions can be dismissed or withdrawn. The checks come from `decisionProblem`, the same ones the backend applies.

### ViolationHistory

A player's record on the ladder: four steps (warning, short suspension, long suspension, disqualification), filled as far as the number of violations, and the entries under it, newest first, each with who decided and why. A suspension that is still running says until when.

```ts
import { ViolationHistory } from '@/contest/components/ViolationHistory'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `violations` *(required)* | `Violation[]` |  | The violations of one player. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The clock, in milliseconds. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<ViolationHistory violations={violations.filter((v) => v.participantId === id)} now={now} />
```

### ReportLog

What was decided, newest first. Reports closed by one decision are one row, with who reported, the reasons and the note of the moderator.

```ts
import { ReportLog } from '@/contest/components/ReportLog'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reports` *(required)* | `Report[]` |  | Handled reports: the ones with a resolution. Reports without one are ignored. |
| `targetName` *(required)* | `(report: Report) => string` |  | The name of the player or the text of the question. |
| `reporterName` *(required)* | `(id: string) => string` |  | A readable name for a reporter. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The clock, in milliseconds. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<ReportLog reports={reports} targetName={nameOf} reporterName={personName} now={now} />
```
